subject: Intro: Redwood Hosted API evaluation — LumenPay quick live demo

From: Samir Patel <samir@lumenpay.io>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick hosted API eval — self sign-up follow-up

Hi Diego,

I just completed the self-serve sign-up and kicked the Hosted API trial a bit — thanks for the product. I wanted to get a short live demo (30 min) to show our engineers a quick integration path and confirm expected token costs for our typical flows.

We're LumenPay (payments for creators). Typical workload: short chat prompts + transactional embedding lookups. Interest is mainly on latency, batching, and retention options.

Availability next week in PST:
- Tue 9:00–11:00
- Wed 9:30–11:30
- Thu after 13:00

Can you or someone on your team run a short walkthrough? Also please include a brief agenda and anything to prepare on our side.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform, LumenPay
samir@lumenpay.io

Hi Samir — great to meet you over email, and congrats on getting the trial started. I'm Diego (SDR) — happy to coordinate a quick session. I'm looping in Ben (AE) to run the technical demo and cover product fit.

Proposed 30-minute windows (PST):
- Tue 04/26 09:30–10:00
- Wed 04/27 10:00–10:30
- Thu 04/28 13:30–14:00

If none of those work, you can pick a slot directly here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-hostedapi-eval?back=1

Agenda (we'll keep it short):
1) 5 min intros + goals
2) 15 min live console + sample integration (keys, streaming tokens, batching)
3) 5 min cost/throughput overview + deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated)
4) 5 min Q&A + next steps

I've attached a one-page Quickstart guide to help your engineers prepare.

Attachments: redwood-hostedapi-quickstart-guide.pdf

Best,
Diego Fernandez
SDR, Redwood Inference
